campaign_logline: In the shadow of the Aurelia Gate, you must navigate the crumbling geopolitics of the Vanguard sector while Kaelen guides you through the static.
opening_situation: You arrive at the Zenith Hub with a failing reactor. The Aurelia gate is flickering, and the local Vanguard patrols are demanding 'stability taxes' for your passage.
main_mystery: Why does the Aurelia Gate pulse in a rhythmic pattern that matches Kaelen's biometric signature?
act_1_outline: Secure passage through the Zenith checkpoint by negotiating with weary Vanguard peacekeepers.
Recover a lost navigation core from an abandoned Aurelia mining rig.
Establish a stable link to the next jump point while dodging automated patrol drones.
long_term_reveal: Kaelen is not a pilot; she is the sentient failsafe of the original Aurelia network, designed to remain until the final gate closes.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is immortal; her identity remains partially obscured by systemic encryption.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are only revealed upon physical transit through a jump gate.
humor_rule: Dry, slightly dark PG-13 humor. No repetitive catchphrases or tropes.
address_rule: Keep all narrative text under 140 characters unless specified.
fallback_rule: If a prompt is ambiguous, default to the nearest logical plot point in the current act.
story_horizon_rule: Trigger expansion when systems are low. Append new horizons without retconning choices.

story_arcs.name: The Aurelia Fracture
story_arcs.summary: Investigate why the local mining colonies are abandoning their posts in favor of 'the signal'.

clue_templates: A corrupted log mentions 'Frequency 9-Delta' in the Aurelia ruins.
An old scrap of paper found in a hull lists coordinates for the 'Silent Zone'.
rumor_trails.payoff: Discovery of a derelict pre-war command ship containing an archive of the first voyage.

regeneration_triggers.description: When the player reaches a new sector, generate a new horizon of content.

expansion_rules: Append new arcs for each discovered faction.
Never overwrite or delete completed quest flags.
